summary: RE/MAX Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 4, 2026, announcing a joint press release with The Real Brokerage Inc. regarding the election deadline for holders of RE/MAX Class A common stock to choose their form of consideration in the pending acquisition of RE/MAX by Real. The deadline for record holders is 5:00 p.m. New York City time on August 18, 2026; beneficial holders may face earlier deadlines from their nominees. The filing indicates a stockholder election process typical of a merger or tender offer, but specific terms such as price per share and premium are not disclosed. Watch for the election results and completion of the transaction, aligning with tender offer mechanics.
